name: Prongs Reef Lighthouse
structure: Circular stone tower with red and white horizontal bands
authority: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL), Mumbai
description: Marks the southern extremity of Prongs Reef at the entrance to Mumbai Harbour.

name: Ratnagiri (Bhagwati) Lighthouse
light_character: Fl (2) W 20s (Double white flash every 20 seconds)
structure: White octagonal masonry tower atop Mirya headland
description: Perched on Bhagwati Fort cliff overlooking Mirya Bay and Mirkarwada fishing harbour.

name: Vengurla Rocks (Burnt Islands) Lighthouse
structure: Cast iron circular tower on offshore rocky islet
description: Isolated offshore reef lighthouse guiding vessels avoiding dangerous shoals south of Malvan.

name: Fort Aguada Lighthouse
structure: White circular masonry tower on 17th-century Portuguese fortress
description: Guards the entrance to Mandovi estuary, Panaji, and Mormugao approaches.

name: Dwarka Point Lighthouse
structure: Square masonry tower with black and white horizontal bands
description: Key landfall mark on the Saurashtra coast at the entrance to the Gulf of Kutch.

name: Bhatkal Lighthouse
structure: White circular concrete tower on Bhatkal hillock
description: Aids coastal navigation between Karwar and Mangalore.

name: Vypin (Cochin) Lighthouse
structure: Tall round concrete tower with red and white bands
description: Primary landfall beacon for Cochin Port and Ernakulam roadstead.

name: Kovalam / Vizhinjam Lighthouse
structure: Round concrete tower with red and white spiral bands
description: Overlooks Kovalam beach and the new Vizhinjam International Transshipment Deepwater Port.

name: Kanyakumari Lighthouse
structure: Round concrete tower with red and white bands
description: Marks the confluence of the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal, and the Indian Ocean at Cape Comorin.

name: Chennai Marina Lighthouse
structure: Triangular concrete tower with red and white bands and radar scanner
description: One of India's few urban lighthouses with an electric lift, facing Marina Beach and Chennai approaches.

name: Dolphin's Nose Lighthouse (Visakhapatnam)
structure: White square masonry tower on promontory 170m above sea level
description: Highest focal plane in mainland India, guarding the major naval and commercial port of Visakhapatnam.

name: Paradip Lighthouse
structure: Circular concrete tower with black and white horizontal bands
description: Aids bulk carriers and trawlers navigating Mahanadi estuary into Paradip Deepwater Port.

name: Sagar Island Lighthouse
structure: Cast iron circular tower with red and white bands
description: Historical navigational beacon guiding merchant shipping through the treacherous Hooghly river sandheads to Kolkata.

name: Indira Point Lighthouse (Great Nicobar)
structure: Cast iron tower with red and white horizontal bands
description: Marks the southernmost point of the Indian Republic and guards the critical Malacca Strait international shipping lane (Six Degree Channel).

name: Minicoy Island Lighthouse
structure: Iconic brick and stone circular tower built by British Imperial Lighthouse Service
description: Vital oceanic guide along the Nine Degree Channel connecting the Arabian Sea to Southeast Asia.
